attempted_reduction: scipy (13.9 MB) and scikit-learn (4.4 MB) arrive as LightGBM dependencies this page never imports. micropip.install("lightgbm", deps=False) does not avoid them: micropip defers to Pyodide's own dependency graph for distributed packages. Tried and measured.

compression.at_rest: The nine boosters ship gzipped (level 9, mtime 0): 30,823,690 B of model text becomes 11,125,154 B on the wire, inflated in the browser. Lossless; the equivalence gate proves the decompressed model bitwise. Without it this first visit would be about 73 MB.
compression.not_compressed: marimo's 297 interface assets (7.0 MB) are served as marimo emits them; compressing them would mean modifying marimo's export.
compression.platform: none — Hugging Face Static Spaces serve files as stored

contrast_with_the_static_page: docs/index.html fetches nothing: 1 request (itself), 0 resources, verified in a browser. At CP-3, marimo export html was rejected for it because it emitted 181 references to cdn.jsdelivr.net. marimo export html-wasm differs in kind: it bundles marimo's frontend locally (297 files served from the Space) and reaches a CDN only for the Python runtime.

cdn.jsdelivr.net.what: Pyodide v314.0.0 core (pyodide.asm.wasm 3.4 MB, python_stdlib.zip 2.5 MB) and wheels: scipy 13.9 MB, scikit-learn 4.4 MB, numpy 2.9 MB, jedi 1.2 MB, pygments 1.2 MB, lightgbm 0.75 MB and seven smaller ones.

files.pythonhosted.org.what: marimo's own wheels, fetched from PyPI by its WASM bootstrap: marimo_base 1.93 MB, narwhals 0.45 MB, pymdown_extensions 0.27 MB, markdown 0.11 MB.

the Space's own origin.source: server wire log of a real cold browser load, uncompressed as Hugging Face serves it; replaying that load's request paths reproduces the figure byte-for-byte
the Space's own origin.what: the nine boosters gzipped at rest (11.1 MB), marimo's interface assets (297 files, 7.0 MB), the row slice, calendar facts, claim set, equivalence fixture and browser_champion.py (0.54 MB), and the page and icons (0.09 MB).

wasm.marimo.app.what: pyodide-lock.json — marimo's lockfile for the Pyodide build it pins; a marimo-operated endpoint contacted once at boot.

method: Cold-cache load of dist/space-wasm served by scripts/measure_wasm_load.py on a previously unused loopback port (the HTTP cache key includes the port) with NO compression, because Hugging Face serves Static Spaces uncompressed: on 2026-09-15 live Static Spaces returned JS, CSS and HTML with no Content-Encoding to a client sending Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br. Same-origin bytes come from the server's wire log; cross-origin bytes from Resource Timing read inside the Pyodide worker. Five cross-origin responses carry no Timing-Allow-Origin, so the browser refuses to size them; those were sized out-of-band with HTTP HEAD and are labelled so.
repeat_visit: Served from the browser cache. The Space executes nothing server-side, so there is nothing to wake.
revision: Round 2. Round 1 gzipped same-origin files on the premise that Hugging Face compresses Static Spaces; it does not, and the published 49 MB understated a first visit. The round-1 Integration Critic caught it; it was verified independently on live Static Spaces before being accepted.
self_reference: The Space serves files that print the cold-load size, so an exact byte count is not stable on its own surfaces; the surfaces publish two-decimal millions of bytes, which a one-byte change cannot move. The exact figure is the final bundle, correct to within a few bytes.

totals.plain_language: about 54 MB on a first visit (53,544,802 bytes = 51.1 MiB), from four hosts

units_note: Published in decimal megabytes (1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes) to two decimals, with exact bytes here.

via_the_huggingface_page.what: Opening the canonical Space link loads Hugging Face's own page, which runs the app in an iframe from the static host. Measured once, read-only, on 2026-09-15 against the already-created Space (then holding template files): the wrapper's document (12,685 B) plus 201 resource entries — huggingface.co 190 requests 953,085 B, js.stripe.com 2 requests 247,693 B, cdnjs.cloudflare.com 1 request 2,955 B, de5282c3ca0c.edge.sdk.awswaf.com 6 requests (sizes not disclosed by the browser), and the static host 2 requests (the iframe, sized inside it). Hugging Face controls that page and it may change; the app's own figures above do not include it.
